//: Type configuration for the test suite only. The application build never reads this file.
Two things differ from tsconfig.json, and only two. Tests are included, because the
app config excludes them. And `.ts` import specifiers are allowed, because the test
files name them explicitly ('../lib/foo.ts') — the app's bundler resolution rejects
that spelling, which is the reason tests were excluded there in the first place.
Everything else, `paths` above all, is inherited. `@/*` therefore means the same
thing in a test as it does in the code under test, which is what lets the suite run
against production modules without any of them being rewritten for the runner's sake.
